laws.statement: When a new message or meeting lands on a conversation (an email thread; a meeting's calendar series) that already holds open commitments, extraction does not just append: ONE reasoned pass (classification tier, the message's OWN words, today injected by code, the cut declared) reads the open items against the message and returns per open item keep · update · superseded_by · delivered · moot and per candidate new · duplicate_of. Code decides what a judgment may do: every non-keep disposition quotes the message verbatim (code-checked) or it is keep; `delivered` only NOMINATES the message to the one fulfillment judge (only a judged delivery closes, and only when the debtor wrote it); superseded/moot settle through one conditional status flip with resolved_reason + a reversible activity row; an update writes only a description or a due the message states, never before the message; a duplicate is not written. Failure keeps everything; at most DELTA_MAX_OPEN items per pass, the rest reported. ONE call site: writeCommitments (mail + meeting). The writer also floors a due earlier than its own source to null (a title naming that past date is no commitment) and folds the counterparty through the person registry and the conversation's own forms (accents, short surnames, bare addresses) so one human never lands under two forms. (W9.4) What reaches that pass is never keyword-gated: every email with words reaches the delta (a no-op without open work), and NEW extraction runs only on a reasoned or structural signal — a meeting source, a user-authored message, or the per-item understanding (ownership you_owe/awaiting · relevance action/reply · an ask · a stated deadline); the kind floor (newsletter · receipt · notification · cold outreach · bulk · broadcast footer) never mints; with no understanding yet, an addressed message extracts and a CC-only one consults the keyword list only as a secondary hint. The sync's triage class noise / fyi_only and the user's to-do capture switch (todo_auto → mintNew=false) stop minting only — the delta still reads the message. (W13.4, owner call Sep 24) The delta is the ONLY anti-hoarding mechanism: presentation never folds a conversation — every live item the delta leaves open is its own Home/held row with its own hands (Done · Dismiss · Open), and nothing is held back for sharing a conversation; grouping related work is a user-created project's job (the W11.2 display fold `one-row-per-conversation` is retired).

laws.name: A PROMISE IS QUOTED OR IT ISN'T A PROMISE
laws.statement: Every commitment extracted from a source (sent mail, inbound mail, meetings) carries `quote`: the EXACT words in the source message that make it — the user's own promise (you_owe from their mail), the user's own ask (awaiting from their mail), the counterparty's ask or promise (inbound), the meeting line (meetings). At the ONE write door (writeCommitments), after the direction floor and before dedup/insert, code checks the quote EXISTS in the message's OWN words (topMessageOf — never the quoted chain; the transcript for a meeting) with THE SAME checker the conversation delta uses (quoteInText: accent/case/quote-mark/whitespace folded, ≥6 chars per fragment, in order). No verifiable quote → no commitment (logged + counted by reason). A USER-AUTHORED you_owe additionally needs the extraction's judgment that the quote is an EXPLICIT FIRST-PERSON commitment to a deliverable or an action (`explicit_promise: true`) — reasoned by the model with the quote as its proof, never a keyword list; a pitch, a capability description, an offer or invitation, a pleasantry or an uncommitted plan is not a promise. The quote is stored on the row (`commitments.source_quote`) and served by THE ONE source reader (lib/commitments/source.ts `sourceQuoteOf` → lead + text + line: "You wrote: '…'" · "<Name> asked: '…'" · "Said in the meeting: '…'"); hosts compose nothing. Code works before the migration (the writer retries without the column; the reader answers null). A meeting caller that hands no transcript is the legacy path: its rows land 'suggested' (the review gate), unquoted, and are counted.

laws.name: THE STAGING LAW
aliases: A STAGED FILE IS THE DELIVERABLE, OR IT ISN'T STAGED
RELATED IS NOT IS, IN TIME
THE BASE IS NOT THE ANSWER (stagingRole)
laws.statement: Only the item's own pool material or a same-entity file auto-stages; evidence is quoted and code-checked; a global hit becomes a named suggestion in the ask, never a staged attachment. W13.1: a staged file is the deliverable IN TIME and of the right KIND, or it is not staged. The requirement's kind (`existing` — a document sent as it is · `new_work` — new or revised content still to be produced, even INTO an existing document) is a reasoned field judged in the same pick that matches the file (a kind the judge's inventory states wins); the dates are code-checked against the REQUEST message (a commitment's source email): the file's effective date is the EARLIEST it can be (its own name's date, when we first saw it, its conversation's date). New work is never satisfied by a file from on or before the request — that file is offered as the BASE (staged as context under `base:<label>`, never `require:`), the requirement stays an ask/produce; an older file satisfies an existing-artifact ask only when the request names it. A resolver-staged row the law now refuses is unstaged through ONE writer (the pointer row goes, the user's file is never touched, the reason is recorded), and only on a positive demotion — an AI outage never unstages. W13.2: the law is VERSIONED and heals itself — the platform, never an operator. Every resolver-staged `require:` row carries the staging-law version it was verified under (`metadata.stagingLaw`, no migration); a row stamped with an older law, or unstamped, is never read as settled and is re-verified by THE ONE RESOLVER on its next touch (the prepare pass before its lanes, the judge's serving edge, the draft doors): its FILE is put first in the same reasoned pick (the kind rides that call), and the ruling is code's — the same file verified restamps in place (not new supply), another file replaces it, a demotion or a stale row the pick cleanly does not verify is unstaged through the one writer, and an unanswered pick holds (the row stands, still stale, still read as staged — an AI failure never unstages). Bounded: REVERIFY_PER_PASS items per pass (the rest counted and said), one item per open. The repair script is an optional accelerator that calls the same function. W13.6: the base is OFFERED, never lost — for new work the document the content goes into is the reasoned match (code then makes an older one the base), a stale row the current pick cannot verify on a new-work requirement becomes the base when the request names its older file, and the room's ask names it ("Current version (to update): <file>"). W14.1: the inbox doc-send writers stamp the draft's attachment (`stagingStamp()` on `source_data.draft`) and THE ONE READER re-proves an unstamped machine attachment (withdrawn unless a current-law resolver row stages the same file; the user's edit is never judged); and the resolver's standing-file lookup also reads the file carried by the item's own unstaged/withdrawn machine draft (`carriedDraftFiles`) — re-judged first by the same pick, made the base by the same rules (new work · predates the request · named by it), so the base is offered even when no `require:` row survived.

laws.name: THE WATERMARK LAW

laws.name: CORRECTIONS STICK

laws.name: THE DENSITY LAW
laws.statement: A calm Home is a greeting, at most five rows and one composer — density is earned by the day, never padded.

laws.name: THE ATTENTION QUALITY LAWS (Q1–Q8)
laws.statement: The triage deck bands by consequence under a budget, graduates only on a why-now, never restates the settled, and keeps a held-quiet ledger the user can open.

laws.name: THE DEED FLOOR

laws.statement: One predicate decides whether a lane's final say is a deed; a send in chat needs the user's own explicit words, never a model mapping.

laws.name: THE ROW TAG + THE ROOM-DOOR LAW
laws.statement: Every deck row derives its project tag from the entity link against the tracked registry on the served payload, and a project-member row opens its project room.

laws.name: THE STAMPED CACHE
laws.statement: A local cache is stamped and an action surface never paints from one too old to trust; only a valid response replaces state (last-good), and a stale 'running' row never paints.

laws.name: THE WORK-ITEM SPINE
aliases: AN UNDATED ITEM CAN NEVER BE OVERDUE
AN AUTOMATED NOTICE CAN NEVER BE OVERDUE
THE DONE SIDE NEVER EVICTS THE LIVE SIDE (SP1–SP5)
laws.statement: The read-time spine maps commitments, actionable items and deliverables to one shape: an undated or automated item is never overdue, and the done side never evicts the live side.

laws.name: THE NOTICE LAW
laws.statement: An automated sender never earns a reply or a chase, but a notice the user owes (payment failed, security, deadline) falls through to an action, never to silent awareness.

laws.name: PRECEDENCE CHAIN, NEVER AN AND
aliases: UNDERSTANDING IS QA BENEATH THE RULES

laws.name: THE PERSON-BRIDGE LAW
aliases: AN INTERNAL COLLEAGUE IS NEVER A BRIDGE
A 1:1 SYNC IS A CHANNEL, NOT A PROJECT
laws.statement: An internal or same-domain person never bridges an item to an entity; people-first recall weights distinctive people by rarity, and a recurring sync is a channel, not a project.

laws.name: THE DISTINCTIVE-TOKEN LAW
laws.statement: Name matching uses distinctive, word-bounded tokens from the user's own words only — a generic token never binds an item, a workflow or a filing to an entity; ambiguity resolves to none.

laws.name: RECOGNITION IS IDENTITY-FIRST, PROVENANCE-FIRST
aliases: A DERIVED ITEM INHERITS ITS PARENT'S ENTITY
laws.statement: A derived item inherits its parent's entity structurally, recall is people-first with topic only a tiebreaker, and a named subject vetoes a people-match into founding the named work.

collides_with.precedence: the veto is the token law applied to the entity's identity, never its summary

laws.name: MEMBERSHIP RECONCILE
aliases: A MEETING MOVE CASCADES ITS COMMITMENTS
laws.statement: Any membership change re-reasons both source and destination entities and cascades a meeting's move to its own commitments; a manual move can never split a meeting from its action items.

collides_with.precedence: pinning wins

laws.name: THE LAW-6 LEDGER GRAMMAR
laws.statement: Entity state speaks one claim about what is owed, settled lines speak history never open-debt grammar, and the narration speaks deltas, never events.

laws.name: THE OVERLAY LAW
aliases: ANCHORED PANELS ESCAPE THEIR CLIPPING ANCESTORS
laws.statement: An anchored panel portals out of its clipping ancestors through one primitive, and every 'Add to project' door speaks one picker grammar.

aliases: A SUPPLY IS AN ANSWER, NOT AN ARRIVAL

aliases: SEND RIDES THE ONE COMMIT DOOR

THE GATE IS NEVER THE DELIVERABLE

laws.name: THE ARITHMETIC FLOOR
laws.statement: Computable claims are recomputed by code from quoted operands that exist in the source; an invented operand drops the check and a failed check is a revise, never a verdict.

laws.name: THE RENDER-VERIFICATION GATE
aliases: THE TEMPLATE TIER IS THE FLOOR
laws.statement: A compiled document must render (page count printed by the sandbox) and pass magic-byte validation, with one stderr-carrying repair, or it yields to the template tier.

laws.name: THE FRAME SERIES — NEVER A TWIN
aliases: A SHARE IS A VIEW OF THE PRESENT
laws.statement: A workflow's frame has one head id updated in place with versions behind it; the public share is structurally query-blind and revoke is an instant, indistinguishable 404.

laws.name: FRAMES TELL THE TRUTH AND FIT
laws.statement: A truncated frame generation is detected structurally and retried compacted, every failure exit logs its cause, and frame chrome carries only dates present in the material or the code-provided today.

collides_with.precedence: the chrome rule is time truth applied to decorative text

laws.name: THE VERIFY GATE (the structured verdict)
aliases: THE BRIEF · YOUR RULES · THE STEP'S OWN ASK
laws.statement: The verify step returns the corrected draft plus a structured verdict whose block is honoured only with a rule finding and forced by a block-demanding rule; degradation is a deterministic floor, never a fabricated pass; the sentinel never leaks.

laws.name: THE PINNED STATION
laws.statement: The verify gate is seated by code on every steps mutation, auto-seats when an external-material or send step is added, and the inline insert is hidden where the seat would teleport it.

laws.name: THE STANDING BINDING
aliases: A SCHEDULED WORKFLOW HOLDS ONE OPEN COMMITMENT
laws.statement: A scheduled workflow holds exactly one open commitment advanced only by a successful run; the judge returns structural none for it; a human dismissal sticks; a spoken standing task prepares a code-validated spec that commits only on one explicit confirm.

laws.name: MANY DOORS, ONE RUN
laws.statement: A workflow's triggers are an any-of list read through one normalizer; authoring resolves by name with ambiguity refused; no editor may silently overwrite a trigger.

laws.name: DOORS ARE STRUCTURAL-BROAD + FILTERS FAIL CLOSED
laws.statement: A door's when names the kind of thing that arrives, never fit-for-a-role; deterministic filters gate candidacy before the judge and fail closed; material rides the fired run only, never the judge; a workflow never fires itself.

laws.name: THE THROTTLE, NEVER A SHREDDER
laws.statement: A per-workflow daily fire limit queues, never drops; deferred fires drain oldest-first under one atomic start claim shared by kick, backstop and drain.

laws.name: A SUBPROCESS IS A HANDOFF TO A MACHINE
laws.statement: A subprocess parks the parent through the existing awaiting machinery with an insert-first claim, resumes atomically, propagates failure spoken, and refuses depth beyond one or a cycle.

laws.name: A CASE IS AN ENTITY
aliases: A FILED FILE IS A VISIBLE FILE
laws.statement: A case is a machine-founded untracked entity resolved by one stated key or one classification bound to the user's instruction; the run reads its case's accumulated page and a recorded conclusion is restated as settled unless the new arrival changes it.

collides_with.precedence: a case is untracked by construction — the machine may archive it

laws.name: THE RUBRIC RIDES VERBATIM BY CODE
laws.statement: A pasted rubric is placed verbatim by code where the model marks the slot; placeholder stripping is span-scoped and the original survives whole if less than 60% would.

laws.name: THE PLACED-GATES LAW
aliases: CODE SEATS WHAT THE MODEL UNDER-EMITS
laws.statement: The one-gate cap applies to gates the model invents, never to gates the user placed in their own text; missing placed gates are seated by code, counted by occurrence never by line.

laws.name: THE HANDOFF LAWS
laws.statement: The owner is the accountability layer while execution identity stays the creator; only the owner or the assignee may resume (a stranger is indistinguishable from not-found); name resolution refuses ambiguity; a coworker-less workflow speaks as the owner's assistant, never generic.

laws.name: THE RUN RECORD NEVER FABRICATES
aliases: A TEST AUTO-PASS IS NOT A HUMAN DECISION
laws.statement: A run's decisions and drift chips are derived only from recorded facts — never a borrowed SLA, never 'You' for a nameless decider — and past holders may read while only the current holder may resume.

laws.name: THE DELETE DOOR IS A RESOLUTION DOOR
aliases: WORKFLOW DELETE SETTLES EVERYTHING LIVING ON IT
laws.statement: Deleting a workflow settles every live run, gate ask and standing binding on it before the row dies — a deleted workflow leaves no orphan ask on the deck.

laws.name: THE CAPABILITY MAP IS THE ONE REGISTRY
aliases: ONE REGISTRY, EVERY VERB HAS HANDS
laws.statement: Every verb, component and capability lives in one registry; a verb without a preparation path is a build error; adding a capability touches one row, never the classifier, proposer or assembler.

laws.name: WORKSPACE FEATURE GATING
aliases: ADDING A TOOL = ONE LINE IN THE MAP
laws.statement: One map binds each tool to its workspace feature and every surface (chat, AgentOS, Studio, generate-config) reads it, so a disabled feature cannot drift back through any door.

laws.name: THE MODEL PARAM FLOOR

A FIX THAT NAMES ONE ACCOUNT IS A REPAIR SCRIPT

laws.name: THE ANCHOR LAW
laws.statement: A user-stated weekday outranks a model-derived date (user-weekday → date-anchor → untouched); an off-by-one is corrected, never laundered.

laws.name: THE SCHEDULE WINDOW LAWS
aliases: A BLOCK IN PROGRESS AT WINDOW START IS BUSY

laws.name: THE DEPARTURE LAW
aliases: PRUNE ONLY AFTER A COMPLETE FETCH
laws.statement: A sync prunes departed rows only after a complete, paginated fetch scoped to user, connection, provider and window — a partial pull never mass-deletes.

laws.name: THE USER'S CLOCK
laws.statement: The judge reasons at the user's local day and hour from their own calendar; expiry needs a code-verified stated date or time behind that clock, and the weekday is stated by code, never derived.

collides_with.precedence: domain instance

laws.name: THE DATED-SOURCE LAW
aliases: EVERY INGESTION PATH CARRIES ITS DATE
laws.statement: Every fetched page, feed item and search result carries its published date or an explicit UNDATED warning; every AI step has a clock; and a news pipeline ends in a verification gate that keeps the draft's structure.

collides_with.precedence: domain instance for ingested sources

laws.name: THE BRIEFING EDITORIAL LAW
laws.statement: A client briefing workflow observes and never advises, applies its stated market filter at selection and synthesis, removes third-country items unconditionally, and re-earns its editorial gate after every prompt edit — all as workflow configuration, never code.

laws.name: THE MATCHING EVIDENCE LAW
laws.statement: A match must quote the profile's own text (code-checked), a self-refuting rationale is not a claim, ties break deterministically never alphabetically, user criteria steer but cannot override the evidence law, and the report always states concentration.

laws.name: ONE STRUCTURED TENDER READER
laws.statement: One reader serves both consumers with a code-side day window, folds amendments by procedure, keeps value-unknown rows flagged rather than dropped, and retries transport once.

laws.statement: Every kind tab equals loose plus the sum of folders on live accounts; renaming a folder re-points every workflow step and manifest atomically with rollback, by exact name only.

laws.name: THE FOLDER NAME LADDER
aliases: GUESS WITHIN ONE FOLDER'S SPELLINGS, NEVER BETWEEN FOLDERS

laws.name: THE SEED KIT IS IDEMPOTENT
laws.statement: Seeding clones through the real indexer with content-hash skip so re-apply costs nothing; a stuck row (text, zero chunks) is healed; workspace settings are merge-written, never clobbered.

laws.name: RECORDING SURVIVABILITY
aliases: A RECORDING SURVIVES ITS TAB AND ITS SERVER

laws.name: THE USER-CONTEXT LANE
aliases: STATED FACTS LAND AT USER SCOPE

aliases: THE LAST STEPS ARE THE MOST LOAD-BEARING
